title: GoogleSearch execution never completes, continuing to waste tokens

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides clear reproduction steps and reports an actionable bug where GoogleSearch execution fails to complete.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The issue is caused by passing this.context.config instead of this.context to WebSearchToolInvocation in packages/core/src/tools/web-search.ts. Fixing this requires a single-file code edit in web-search.ts and updating its corresponding test in packages/core/src/tools/web-search.test.ts.

summary.problem: When using GoogleSearch (e.g. running queries like 'Search online for how to use Flutter's Riverpod package and explain it.'), tool execution fails to complete properly.
summary.root_cause: In packages/core/src/tools/web-search.ts, WebSearchTool.createInvocation passes this.context.config instead of this.context to WebSearchToolInvocation. Because this.context.config is a Config instance rather than an AgentLoopContext, WebSearchToolInvocation lacks proper execution context during tool execution.
summary.context: WebFetchTool correctly passes this.context to its invocation constructor, but WebSearchTool erroneously passed this.context.config. Additionally, unit tests in packages/core/src/tools/web-search.test.ts masked this issue by mocking .config to point back to the mock config.

steps: In packages/core/src/tools/web-search.ts, update WebSearchTool.createInvocation to pass this.context instead of this.context.config when instantiating WebSearchToolInvocation.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: WebSearchToolInvocation receives the full AgentLoopContext instance during instantiation and executes web search queries successfully.
verification_steps: In packages/core/src/tools/web-search.test.ts, update test context setup to mock a proper AgentLoopContext object containing config and geminiClient without adding a circular config.config property.
Run npm test packages/core/src/tools/web-search.test.ts using Vitest to verify all web search tests pass.
